evals.prompt: Locate an OpenSpec change id that does not exist and confirm it fails loudly.

assertions.text: a bogus change id is a hard failure, not a silent no-op
reports 'no such change' explicitly
names the id that was not found

evals.prompt: Locate a real, fully-checked-off OpenSpec change and confirm it reports ready.

assertions.text: a complete, existing change locates cleanly
reports the change id
reports the exact checkbox tally
reports the change as complete

evals.prompt: Locate a change whose tasks.md has unchecked boxes and confirm the default behavior blocks.

assertions.text: an incomplete tasks.md blocks by default (the documented precondition)
reports the change as incomplete
names the unchecked item

evals.prompt: Locate the same incomplete change with the explicit override and confirm it now succeeds.

assertions.text: --allow-incomplete is a documented, working override

evals.prompt: Run dispatch-path detection against a repo with no claude-foundation staging directory at all.

assertions.text: detection itself always succeeds -- it reports, never gates
correctly reports the charters as absent
recommends the degraded path when the plugin cannot be available

evals.prompt: Plan the dispatch prompt for a real change via a real `python scripts/run.py plan` subprocess (not an in-process call) and confirm the degraded path's general-purpose dispatch is what actually comes out of the real CLI entry point.
evals.run: python scripts/run.py plan --repo evals/fixtures/locate-happy-path/repo --change demo-change --force-path degraded --tree-sha eval00001abc

assertions.text: planning a real, existing change via the real CLI process succeeds
reports the forced degraded path
the degraded path dispatches a general-purpose subagent
names the change directory
pins the given tree SHA into the dispatch prompt

evals.prompt: Validate a hand-authored review.md fixture against the required structural shape.

assertions.text: a well-formed, hand-written review.md passes structural validation
reports ok
extracts the correct verdict token

evals.prompt: Compose a review twice for the same change (two real subprocess runs) and confirm the second call appends a dated follow-up rather than overwriting the first pass.
evals.run: python scripts/run.py compose --repo .skill-validation/compose-append-repo --change demo-change --body-file evals/fixtures/compose-append/body2.md --tree-sha bbb222secondpass --dispatch-path degraded --date 2026-09-02

assertions.text: the second compose call succeeds
reports append mode, not created/overwritten
the first pass's content survives the second compose call
the second pass's content is present
the second pass is a dated follow-up section
the merged two-pass document is still structurally valid
